_about: Screen texts for the ten screens in CLAUDE.md 'Site rules'. Sentences of eight words or fewer, no science words (those live in glossary.json). {placeholders} are filled by the pipeline (fill_registry.json); 'when' names a condition in fill_registry.json. The site is text only: no audio (owner, 2026-11-12). Every Nepali text was drafted by SI (Claude) on 2026-11-12 and needs native-speaker review before export; each node carries ne_review until a reviewer replaces it with their name and date. Months (owner, 2026-11-12, choice 7): in Nepali each month key is named by the Bikram Sambat month that begins in it, about the middle of the Gregorian month, with the approximate Gregorian months beside it, e.g. 'Apr' = बैशाख (अप्रिल–मे), Gregorian names in Devanagari (owner's batch decisions item 22). They do not line up exactly (each BS month starts on a slightly different day each year; TODO-VERIFY the start days against a published Nepali calendar), so every screen that names a month carries 'months_note'. English stays Gregorian.

texts.ne: तपाईंको उपत्यका: करिब १० किलोमिटर चौडा नक्साबाट।

texts.en: Your region: a map 50 km or wider.
texts.ne: तपाईंको क्षेत्र: ५० किलोमिटर वा बढी चौडा नक्साबाट।

texts.en: This number uses our corrected rain record.
texts.ne: यो अङ्कमा हाम्रो मिलाइएको वर्षा अभिलेख छ।

texts.en: How we checked your rain record.
texts.ne: हामीले तपाईंको वर्षा अभिलेख कसरी जाँच्यौं।

texts.en: We checked this field's rain record.
texts.ne: हामीले यो खेतको वर्षा अभिलेख जाँच्यौं।

texts.en: Every field runs this check by itself.
texts.ne: हरेक खेतमा यो जाँच आफैँ चल्छ।

texts.en: From {rain_fix_year}, fewer gauges fed the rain map.
texts.ne: {rain_fix_year} देखि वर्षाको नक्सामा मापक धेरै घटे।

texts.en: No change found. We use the rain as published.
texts.ne: कुनै फरक भेटिएन। प्रकाशित वर्षा नै प्रयोग गर्छौं।

texts.en: Share of rain gauges inside the rain map:
Rain gauges counted near this field:
texts.ne: यो खेत नजिक गनिएका वर्षा मापक:

texts.en: Another rain map, CHIRPS, stayed steady.
texts.ne: अर्को वर्षा नक्सा, CHIRPS, स्थिर रह्यो।

texts.en: Ours stepped up, compared with it:
A version made without gauges stepped up less.
Nepal's weather office, usual rain a year:
texts.ne: नेपालको मौसम कार्यालय, वर्षको सामान्य वर्षा:

texts.en: The rain map, compared with it:
From {rain_fix_year}, rain is scaled back each month.
texts.ne: {rain_fix_year} देखि हरेक महिनाको वर्षा घटाएर मिलाइयो।

texts.en: Then we matched it to rain gauges.
Rain a year, counted different ways
Like the nearby town's usual rain
Numbers with this mark use our corrected rain.
texts.ne: यो चिन्ह भएका अङ्कमा मिलाइएको वर्षा छ।

top.en: What usually happens here: {year_count} years of records.
top.ne: यहाँ प्रायः के हुन्छ: {year_count} वर्षको अभिलेख।

tip_cold.en: Cover young plants on frosty nights.
tip_cold.ne: सफा, चिसो रातमा साना बिरुवा छोप्नुहोस्।

tip_heat.en: Water in the evening on hot days.

tip_dry_spell.en: Water before flowering if no rain.

none_seen.en: Not seen in these years. Good news.

frost_note1.en: Our cold nights may be too many.
frost_note1.ne: हाम्रा चिसो रात धेरै गनिएका हुन सक्छन्।

frost_note2.en: Bhaktapur's own nights are often colder.
frost_note2.ne: भक्तपुरका आफ्नै रात प्रायः अझ चिसो हुन्छन्।

big_rain_note1.en: Big rain here means 20 mm a day.
big_rain_note1.ne: यहाँ ठूलो पानी भनेको दिनमा २० मिमि।

big_rain_note2.en: The weather office calls 50 mm heavy.

dry_note.en: A dry day has under 1 mm.

step1.en: NASA watched your area for {year_count} years.

step2.en: Our computer makes a copy of your field.
step2.ne: हाम्रो कम्प्युटरले तपाईंको खेतको नक्कल बनाउँछ।

step3.en: It tries each plan in every year.
step3.ne: यसले हरेक योजना हरेक वर्षमा चलाउँछ।

step4.en: Your soil stick checks the soil today.

step4_sub.en: Then the app says what to do.

better_means.en: Better means more of its water need met.
better_means.ne: राम्रो भनेको चाहिने पानी बढी पुग्यो।

home_line.en: We tested each plan in {year_count} past years.
home_line.ne: हामीले हरेक योजना {year_count} वर्षको मौसममा जाँच्यौं।

wx_hurt_dry_spell.ne: हप्तौं पानी नपर्दा {crop}लाई हानि हुन सक्छ।

wx_hurt_big_rain_sowing.ne: ठूलो पानीले {crop} लगाउने काम बिगार्न सक्छ।

wx_hurt_big_rain_harvest.ne: ठूलो पानीले {crop} भित्र्याउने काम बिगार्न सक्छ।

today_drier.en: Part {section} is drier than the others.

today_wetter.en: Part {section} is wetter than the others.

twin3_1.en: We copy your field into a computer.
twin3_1.ne: हामी तपाईंको खेत कम्प्युटरमा नक्कल गर्छौं।

twin3_2.en: We replay {year_count} years of NASA weather.

twin3_2b.en: Each crop plan, in every year.

twin3_3.en: We keep the plan that works most often.
twin3_3.ne: धेरैपटक सफल हुने योजना हामी राख्छौं।

twin3_3b.en: Then we tell you what to do.
twin3_3b.ne: अनि के गर्ने भनेर हामी बताउँछौं।

anim_title.en: Each plan in every past season

judges_link.ne: निर्णायकका लागि: हामीलाई कसरी थाहा भयो

behind_title.en: Behind the scenes: your field, seen by NASA
behind_title.ne: पर्दा पछाडि: नासाले देखेको तपाईंको खेत

world_link.en: See every field on a world map

world_tap.en: Tap a field to open it.

world_map_src.en: World outline: Natural Earth, public domain.

world_own_title.en: Run it for your own field

world_step_1.en: Write down your field's corners and crops.
world_step_1.ne: आफ्नो खेतका कुना र बाली लेख्नुहोस्।

world_step_2.en: Download NASA's free records for that place.
world_step_2.ne: त्यो ठाउँको नासाको निःशुल्क रेकर्ड डाउनलोड गर्नुहोस्।

world_step_3.en: Run one command. It builds every page.
world_step_3.ne: एउटा आदेश चलाउनुहोस्। यसले सबै पाना बनाउँछ।

world_sea.en: This is sea on our map.

world_covers.en: NASA's free records for this spot:
world_covers.ne: यो ठाउँका लागि नासाका निःशुल्क रेकर्ड:

world_caution.en: Less sure over snow and ice

world_crops_need.en: Which fit needs this field's own records.

world_nm_other.en: Crops we don't know, like soybean

world_one_command.en: One command on a laptop prepares it.

world_hours.en: It takes a few hours of downloads.

world_no_numbers.en: No harvest numbers until it is prepared.

world_here.en: This spot is a prepared field.

world_any_5.en: How sure we are, on every answer
world_any_5.ne: हरेक उत्तरमा हामी कति पक्का छौं

world_np_1.en: Records and checks of Nepal's weather office
world_np_1.ne: नेपालको मौसम कार्यालयका रेकर्ड र जाँच

world_np_3.en: The Nepali words, checked by people

years_tap.en: Tap a square to see the year

none_better.en: None of our other plans usually did better.
none_better.ne: हाम्रा अरू कुनै योजनाले प्रायः राम्रो गरेनन्।

fog_line.en: From space, we guess. Our soil stick checks. The fog clears where we test.
fog_line.ne: अन्तरिक्षबाट हामी अनुमान गर्छौं। हाम्रो माटो जाँच्ने यन्त्रले जाँच्छ। जहाँ जाँच्छौं, त्यहाँ कुहिरो हट्छ।

sure_wait.en: Not yet: the stick needs its cup test.
sure_wait.ne: अझै छैन: पहिले यन्त्रको कप जाँच चाहिन्छ।

fog_test.en: Tests away from the field clear no fog.

fog_p1.en: From space, we make a first guess.

fog_p2.en: Our soil stick reads one spot exactly.
fog_p2.ne: हाम्रो माटो जाँच्ने यन्त्रले एउटा ठाउँ ठ्याक्कै नाप्छ।

fog_p3.en: We mix the two, trusting the surer one.
fog_p3.ne: हामी दुवै मिलाउँछौं, बढी पक्कालाई बढी भरोसा गर्दै।

fog_p4.en: So the fog clears where we test.

welcome.note: The loading curtain's welcome (owner, 2026-11-15): this word in the site's 7 languages, one after another, Nepali first. The words are the owner's own (not machine-translated). site/index.html carries the same words for the first paint (tests/test_site_welcome.py keeps the two the same).

label.en: Demo: 4 pots stand in for a field. This phone stands in for our drone.
label.ne: डेमो: खेतको सट्टा ४ वटा गमला छन्। हाम्रो ड्रोनको सट्टा यो फोन छ।

stays.en: The photo stays on this phone.

no_photo.en: No photo yet. Take one from above first.
no_photo.ne: अहिलेसम्म फोटो छैन। पहिले माथिबाट खिच्नुहोस्।

start.en: Push the soil stick into pot 1.
start.ne: माटो जाँच्ने यन्त्र गमला १ मा घुसाउनुहोस्।

pot_wetter.en: Pot {section} is wetter than the others.

pot_drier.en: Pot {section} is drier than the others.

fit_guide.en: Fit the 4 pots inside the square.

fit_drag.en: Drag the corners to fit the 4 pots.

line.ne: अफलाइन: तपाईंको सुरक्षित गरिएको खेत देखाउँदै।
